bug_semantics: taro-css-to-react-native transform() parses CSS and, for every declaration, calls remToPx() in packages/css-to-react-native/src/transforms/rem.js before any other unit handling in packages/css-to-react-native/src/index.js transformDecls. remToPx used the global regex /(\d*\.?\d+)rem/g: nested \d* / \.? / \d+ on a long digit run that is not a rem unit (the PR PoC is 100000 zeros plus a trailing 'p' as a property value) causes polynomial backtracking and hangs conversion (CWE-1333 ReDoS). A later Taro-only branch in transformDecls used /(\d+)px/ and /(\d+)px/g when options.scalable===false; that pattern is related inefficient-regex hardening in the same patch, but the demonstrated hang is remToPx, which always runs first. CVE-2025-5896 remains PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected).
flaw_origin: The hanging rem regex was first written into nervjs/taro when Pines-Cheng vendored kristerkari/css-to-react-native-transform as packages/css-to-react-native (README: fork from that package; upstream rem.js already had the same /(\d*\.?\d+)rem/g from its 2017 initial commit). Immediate parent a2de977f has no css-to-react-native tree and no remToPx. 256556349d45 only restyled rem.js (eslint/quote wrap) and is not a first-write. The index.js /(\d+)px/ form arrived later in bc4fa8c7a119 (2021-11-05) replacing a non-ReDoS /px/ check; it is a second instance, not the BIC of the PoCed mechanism.
